messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering - multiple customers reporting 'usage not updating' in the dashboard. Triggered by 1950001200. Paging oncall.
alex: acked. i'm on it, will start triage. @maria-sre please stand by for logs. :eyes:
maria-sre: pulling meter-aggregation logs now. i see a spike of 5000 errors at 11:02 UTC against the ingestion worker pool. stack traces show timeouts to kafka.
alex: thanks. any quick mitigation? can we flip to fallback aggregator group? or restart the affected worker set?
liam-eng: we can restart the ingestion-workers-batch-3 autoscaling group. doing a rolling restart now. cmd: ``kubectl -n billing rollout restart deploy/ingestion-workers-batch-3``
incident-bot: Deploy started by liam-eng for ingestion-workers-batch-3. Monitor: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1950001234
jamie-cs: CS has 3 active tickets from enterprise customers asking about missing usage for today. They want ETA to communicate.
alex: estimate 8-12m for restart to stabilize. i'll keep updates every 5m. if restart doesn't clear errors we'll failover to archived-writer and enable queued-reprocess.
maria-sre: restart shows reduced error rate, but one consumer partition still lagging ~45s. kafka broker 4 shows brief GC spikes around the incident window. raising an ops incident to infra team.
oncall-rot: I've notified infra and outbound alerting. also flagged potential duplicate invoice risk if reprocessing runs twice — add idempotency guard before re-ingest.
liam-eng: good call. adding dedupe by event_id in the requeue worker. patch pushed to staging, will promote after acceptance tests.
jamie-cs: preparing a short CS update: "We're investigating a metering ingestion issue affecting usage display; team is actively mitigating. No invoices sent yet. We'll share ETA within 30 minutes." ok to post to affected accounts?
nisha-pm: yes, let's be proactive. also want a status page draft for public visibility.
alex: draft for status page (short): "Partial outage: usage display delayed for some customers. Root cause: ingestion consumer errors causing backlog. Mitigation: rolling restart of ingestion workers and controlled reprocessing. Customer impact: dashboards may show stale usage; billing systems are paused to avoid incorrect invoices. ETA: updates within 30 minutes." thumbs?
jamie-cs: :thumbsup: maybe add contact link for urgent billing questions.
billing-bot: Note from billing: invoice generation is currently disabled for affected accounts. Tagging invoices created after 1950000000 with hold=true until reconciliation complete.
maria-sre: moving to run query to quantify affected customers. SQL (approx):
```
SELECT account_id, max(event_ts) as last_event
FROM meter_events
WHERE event_ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING max(event_ts) < now() - interval '1 hour';
```
Estimate ~120 accounts from quick scan.
alex: good. jamie please prepare two templates: 1) short public status page, 2) detailed customer email for affected enterprise accounts. i'll post the public status page now.
jamie-cs: public status page update ready. content: "We are investigating delayed usage reporting for a subset of customers. Engineers are mitigating; invoices are on hold. We will update in 30 minutes or sooner." Publishing now.
incident-bot: Status page updated by alex: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1950001234
liam-eng: we validated the dedupe guard locally; promoting to canary for reprocess flow. starting canary reprocess for 10 accounts.
maria-sre: canary looks good, no duplicates for 2k events. error rate down to baseline. queuing full-reprocess for backlog with rate-limit 5000/s and dedupe enabled.
alex: nice. planning handoff in 20 minutes to morning oncall. need follow-ups: - post-mortem owner - reconciliation script to mark reprocessed events - customer notification send list
nisha-pm: i'll own post-mortem. jamie please own customer comms send. billing team to own invoice reconciliation and hold releases.
jamie-cs: customer email draft for enterprise (detailed): "Hi <Customer>,

We're reaching out because some of the usage for your account may not have appeared in the dashboard between 11:00–11:20 UTC on <date>. Our engineers identified an ingestion consumer error and restarted the processing pipeline. No invoices were generated during the incident window; we have placed a hold on invoice issuance for affected accounts while we reconcile.

What we're doing: full reprocessing with deduplication, verifying counts, and holding invoice generation until reconciliation completes.

ETA: Reprocessing in progress; expected completion in 2 hours. We'll notify you when your dashboard has the corrected usage and when invoice issuance resumes.

If this caused any operational impact, please reply and we'll escalate immediately.

— Redwood Billing Team"
ok to send once reconciliation verification passes?
alex: yes, send after we confirm reprocessed totals match expected ranges and no duplicates. include contact link and severity phone number for enterprise.
billing-bot: created internal ticket BILL-195000 for reconciliation and marking invoices with hold=true. assigned to billing-ops.
oncall-rot: handing off to morning shift: summary: ingestion consumer error caused delayed usage display for ~120 accounts. mitigated by rolling restart + controlled reprocess with dedupe. invoices held. follow-ups: reconciliation (BILL-195000), post-mortem (nisha), customer sends (jamie). See logs and runbook link: https://go/ops/runbooks/metering-reprocess
alex: handoff ack. i'll add final notes to the thread and set a reminder for check-in 2 hours. good job team. :v:
maria-sre: will keep alerting muted but monitoring key metrics. reopening if any regression.
jamie-cs: queued email send list ready; will hold until recon complete. will craft a shorter slack-friendly CS FAQ for support channels.
liam-eng: infra confirmed GC patch and we're scheduling broker maintenance this weekend to reduce hotspots.
alex: closing pager for now — tags: mitigated, reprocessing-in-progress. reopen if new errors spike.
incident-bot: Pager closed by alex. Duration: 18m. Follow-up tickets: BILL-195000, PM-195010 (post-mortem).
